data.title: Real use case: Brex expense review
data.summary: A provider-published customer story describes Claude inside a spend-management product, beyond a standalone chat demo.

facts.text: Anthropic’s Brex case study describes Claude on Amazon Bedrock supporting expense workflows and transaction anomaly review. Its impact figures are customer/provider reports, not independently reproduced Sintra measurements.

sources.title: Brex reimagines spend management with Claude in Amazon Bedrock

prerequisites: For a similar pilot: an approved sample of expenses, receipts, policy rules and reviewer labels.
steps: For your own pilot, extract structured fields and flag policy exceptions without auto-approving expenses.
Evaluate missed exceptions and false alarms against reviewer labels.
data.output: An implementation pattern and a measurable pilot design.
validation: Report extraction accuracy, missed exceptions and false-positive rates on a held-out sample.
Do not transfer the customer’s reported savings to your own business case.
limitations: This is a documented customer story, not a newly announced product or a Sintra deployment.
The source does not establish a universal return on investment.
